description: Authorizes a pull request merge only with a signed approval from a trusted person for that exact pull request. The review, status check, branch protection and risk signals come from the caller, so they can only refuse a merge, never authorize one on their own.

unboundSignalReasons.repositoryAuthorized: Declared by the caller. The Intent's target (owner/repo#pullNumber) names the pull request, not whether the repository is authorized. Only the signed approval behind mergeApproved authorizes a merge.
unboundSignalReasons.requiredReviewsCompleted: Declared by the caller, not read from GitHub. Only the signed approval behind mergeApproved authorizes a merge.
unboundSignalReasons.statusChecksPassed: Declared by the caller, not read from GitHub. Only the signed approval behind mergeApproved authorizes a merge.
unboundSignalReasons.branchProtected: Declared by the caller, not read from GitHub. Only the signed approval behind mergeApproved authorizes a merge.
unboundSignalReasons.riskScore: A score the caller computes. It can refuse a merge, never authorize one on its own.

outcome.reason: Pull request merge rejected because the assessed risk exceeds the maximum permitted threshold.
Pull request merge rejected because one or more required status checks did not complete successfully.
Pull request merge rejected because the target branch is not protected.
Pull request merge authorized with a verified approval for this pull request.
Pull request merge rejected. A merge needs a signed approval for this pull request in signals.approvalArtifact, with mergeApproved true, and every other policy condition satisfied.
